name: Dot Communications
summary: Sydney dialup/ISDN + hosting + VISP wholesale ISP; pivoted to Viper ISP billing platform; later defunct.

events.details: Dialup/ISDN, hosting, VISP wholesale. Earliest Wayback capture 21 Dec 1996 (dot.net.au).

Retail ISP homepage last captured Jan 2001; dot.net.au began 302-redirecting in 2002 as the firm refocused on the Viper ISP billing platform. The domain was later reused for an unrelated site (live captures 2011-2025).
